converter: cth_convert_sym_v8.py (a copy of docx_text() of the workbench converter harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py that also maps Symbol-font and private-use characters; kept outside the repository); the first deposit used harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py

symbol_repair_2026_11_07.previous_converter: harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py (docx_text), the converter of the 2026-10-13 deposit
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.from: the same Word document of C2025C00135 (download_sha256 582ff2c3fbbc52dd94f3bb6cadf6626fd5b212c17cf9270940f0eb96aafbd935, unchanged)
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.why: docx_text() dropped characters Word writes as Symbol-font w:sym elements. cth_convert_sym_v8.py maps them to Unicode (Symbol F0BE —, F0B7 •, F0B4 × and the like), Wingdings boxes to "[ ]", and private-use code points U+F0xx the same way; run with its mapping switched off it reproduces the first deposit byte for byte.
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.what_changed: A diff against the first deposit shows only these 2 lines changed (same 6,199 lines, 2 characters more), each one em dash (Symbol F0BE -> —) restored in a section heading: line 1122, '41 Effect of non-compliance with section 38—general' (was '38general'); line 1127, '41A Effect of non-compliance with section 38—certain classes of transactions' (was '38certain'). Line numbers are unchanged, so the formulas sidecar's references (after lines 1159 and 3403) still hold; it quotes neither changed line.
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.encodings_affected: baseline-2026-10 does not encode ss 41 or 41A (the prudential Parts are out of its scope), so no rule, case, value or finding relied on the changed lines or changed; no encoding records the text hash
